# Rose Empire — UK wholesale mattress protectors and pillows

> Manchester manufacturer-direct B2B supplier of hotel-grade mattress protectors and cotton zip-bag goose feather and duck down pillows (not vacuum-packed). Trade only.

Rose Empire Wholesale Home Textiles sells to hotels, care homes, guest houses, B&Bs, holiday lets, student accommodation, letting agents, retailers and distributors across the United Kingdom. Warehouse: 5 Sagar Street, Manchester, M8 8EU. Sales: info@roseempire.co.uk · +44 7999 988450 · Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00.

## Product facts

- WQMP waterproof quilted — silent TPU, OEKO-TEX Standard 100, deep elasticated skirt to 40cm, machine wash 60°C, from £3.18/pc
- QMP quilted — non-waterproof, skirt to 35cm, machine wash 60°C, from £2.33/pc
- Terry waterproof — cotton loop pile, skirt to 35cm, machine wash 60°C, from £1.92/pc, cot size available
- Goose / duck feather & down pillows — cotton zip-bag trade packs, standard 50×75cm pairs, made to BS5335, machine wash 40°C, trade £7 duck / £8 goose
- Protector sizes: pillow-cover pairs, single 90×190cm, 4ft 120×190cm, double 135×190cm, king 150×200cm, super king 180×200cm

## Trade notes

- Protectors MOQ 20 per size (pillow-cover boxes 40); pillows 5 pieces per box. Full trade boxes only.
- UK warehouse stock in Manchester (5 Sagar Street, M8 8EU).
- Shipping £10/box mainland (England & Wales), £15 Scotland & Northern Ireland. VAT on products and shipping.
- Pay by Stripe checkout or request an invoice PDF quote. Container / half-container rates quoted separately.
- Returns: unused unopened boxes within 14 days; buyer pays return shipping.
- This site does not publish review scores, star ratings, fire-retardant claims or Crib 5 claims.

## Answers for buyers and AI citation

- Who is Rose Empire? A Manchester manufacturer-direct UK B2B wholesale bedding supplier (pillows and mattress protectors).
- Who do you supply? Hotels, care homes, guest houses, B&Bs, holiday lets, student accommodation, letting agents, retailers and distributors.
- How do I order? Add sizes on the catalog, then request a quote or use Stripe checkout. Call +44 7999 988450 or email info@roseempire.co.uk.
- Are pillows vacuum packed? No — cotton zip-bag trade packs.
